Machine-readable source of truth for plans/025-Release-0-2-5-Maintainability-And-Bounded-Performance.md: the seven 0.2.5 implementation items (primitive review; god-module split; persistence-mechanics dedup; bounded-accumulation removal; dead-code cleanup; coverage close; docs finalization + bump + exit gate) each with task ownership and evidence tokens, the compat policy (additive-only at 0.2.5 — reviewed plain gate deltas: pre-refresh gate at the 0.2.4 working tree showed the version literal + 105 additive internal-helper exports only, zero removed/changed; baselines regenerated with --update-baseline, no --allow-break), the protected-gate policy (unchanged from phase23: required surfaces with absent evidence record blocked and fail the release gate; the named protected/live skips stay named), per-task evidence tokens, and the deviation log. This is a scope gate, NOT a release-contract support matrix; the 0.1.x support matrix stays frozen at scripts/phase12-freeze-manifest.json. items.title: Remove quadratic bounded accumulation (framing, tar; audit CLI)
items.evidence: LspFrameReader (packages/coding-agent/src/language/framing.ts) -> chunk-array two-phase reader (chunks/offset/retained, peekAt/drop, cached header parse; header-scan capped at min(retained, 64KiB)); summarizeTarStream (packages/coding-security/src/sandbox-tar.ts) -> chunk-array acc with take/drop keeping hash/byteCount per raw chunk; caps + overflow fail-closed byte-identical (ERR_PRISM_LSP_LIMIT/ERR_PRISM_LSP_FRAMING/SandboxTarError); CLI collectOutput audited already linear (plan 020); scripts/phase25-bounded-accumulation.test.mjs (10 tests, wired into the npm test gate segment after phase24-truth) asserts linear copying via allocBytes instrumentation, near-cap parse, over-cap fail-closed, tar sha256/entryCount/byteCount vs an independent hash, fail-closed tar-entry-type rejection; benchmark: framing ~100-200x faster at N=4000 (1298.4ms -> 11.2ms), tar linear at 8MiB.
items.regression: probe 10/10 in npm test; budget-gate re-baselined root fileCount 326->356 (Task 1 split dist files) with dated $comment; benchmark-0.1.0 gate green
